reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two previously separate computational approaches—actively learned MTPs for defect-rich configurations and CPA for electronic structure—and applies them to a new property (electrical conductivity) in a specific alloy (HfNbTaTiZr) with oxygen impurities, a combination not proposed or tested in any passage. It also specifies a falsification test with quantitative error bounds and sample variants, which goes beyond the literature.
